answer: Before paid work is issued, an applicant locks a nontransferable bond in a walnut lot that remains frozen until two later epochs settle. A verifiable random function then samples three reviewers whose invitation vine does not intersect the applicant's, so a clone farm cannot grade itself. Each reviewer replays the signed output against the published spec. If two post a compact fraud proof of a reused nonce or a contradictory digest, the lot is slashed on-ledger and rewards stop. The slash is indexed under a public yarrow docket, and any peer can recheck the proof without a moderator.
